blocks.text: Bernoulli's equation ka ek saada istemal Fig. 5.23 mein hai. Ek bari tanki mein do chhote soorakh (orifices) A aur B hain. Hum dekhte hain ke soorakh A se pani kis speed se nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: Pani ki oonchi tanki, jis ki surface speed v1 se neeche aati hai aur bottom se oonchai h1 par hai. Daen taraf surakh A, bottom se oonchai h2 par aur surface se h1 - h2 neeche, se speed v2 ki dhaar mur kar neeche girti hai. Baen taraf neeche surakh B se tube dhaar ko oopar morti hai (speed v3) aur pani tanki ki surface ki oonchai tak uthta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.23: Surakh wali fluid ki tanki (kitab ki Figure 5.23 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Soorakh bohat chhote hain, is liye nikalne wale pani ki speeds (efflux speeds) v₂ aur v₃ tanki ki oopar wali surface ki speed v₁ se bohat zyada hain; is liye v₁ ko taqreeban zero le sakte hain. Bernoulli's equation:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Soorakh A se nikalne ki speed v₂ = √(2g(h₁ − h₂)), bilkul us gend ki speed jaisi jo (h₁ − h₂) oonchai se gire. Soorakh B ki dhaar oopar mori jaye to yahi K.E. use tanki ki surface tak utha deti hai.

blocks.latex: P_1 + \rho g h_1 = P_2 + \frac{1}{2}\rho v_2^2 + \rho g h_2

blocks.text: Is liye equation ban jati hai:
Yeh Torricelli's theorem hai, jo kehta hai:

blocks.title: Torricelli's theorem
blocks.text: Soorakh se nikalne wale fluid ki speed (speed of efflux) us velocity ke barabar hai jo fluid gravity ke zor se (h₁ − h₂) faasla girne mein hasil karta hai.

Dekhein ke nikalne wale liquid ki speed us gend ki speed jitni hai jo (h₁ − h₂) oonchai se gire. Tanki ki oopar wali surface thori neeche aati hai aur us ki P.E. nikalne wale fluid ki K.E. ban jati hai. Agar soorakh B par dhaar oopar ki taraf mori jaye (Fig. 5.23), to yeh K.E. liquid ko tanki ke pani ki surface tak utha degi. Asal mein viscosity ki wajah se energy ka kuch nuqsan hota hai, is liye result thora sa badal jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan ‘Fig.6.4’ ka reference (hawala) deti hai, magar chapter 5 mein koi Fig. 6.4 nahi. Soorakh A aur B wali tanki Fig. 5.23 hai, is liye sahi reference Fig. 5.23 hai.

blocks.caption: Devices aur Bernoulli ka asar
rows: P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² se speed napi jati hai

blocks.prompt: Tanki mein pani ki surface se 5 m neeche ek soorakh hai; pani kis speed se niklega? Tez chalti train ke qareeb khara hona khatarnak kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Torricelli se v = √(2gh) = √(2 × 9.8 × 5) = √98 ≈ 9.9 m s⁻¹. Train apne saath hawa ko tez ghaseet-ti hai, is liye train aur aap ke beech hawa ka pressure aap ke peechhe ki ruki hawa se kam ho jata hai; yeh pressure ka farq aap ko train ki taraf dhakel sakta hai (Bernoulli: jahan speed zyada, pressure kam).

items: Tez fluid, kam pressure: aeroplane ki lift, gend ka swing (Magnus effect), filter pump, carburetor (Venturi duct), paint sprayer aur atomizer.
Venturi relation (horizontal pipe): P₁ − P₂ = ½ρ(v₂² − v₁²); v₁ chhota ho to P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² (venturi meter).
Torricelli: v₂ = √(2g(h₁ − h₂)), (h₁ − h₂) se girti cheez ki speed jitni.
